caption: The drawing is woven in dark blue and off-white tones. The design includes multiple objects and decorative elements arranged in a grid-like pattern. In the lower left corner, there is an American eagle with a shield on its chest, grasping arrows and a branch, and a banner in its beak reading "E PLURIBUS UNUM." Over the eagle are stars arranged in a curved line. To the left of the eagle is a vertical text that reads "SARAH ELIZA FILMER LEWIS CO. NY 1854." Throughout the composition, there are symmetrical urns or vases holding flowers and fruit with leafy arrangements. Large blooming flowers and leaves, as well as sprays of smaller flowers, are distributed throughout the piece, some in a stylized, geometric orientation. Curved, leafy vines and floral motifs fill the remaining space, separated by patterned or zigzag border bands. The overall appearance is highly patterned, with light designs standing out against the dark blue woven background.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
